items.Title: MCV Structural Engineer
items.ExternalDescriptionStr:
Engineering & Design

    •    Develop grillage and sea-fastening designs, including steel structures, load‑spreading arrangements, and securing components for project cargo.
•    Prepare structural calculations, FEM analyses, and design reports according to required engineering standards.
•    Review cargo drawings, COGs, load cases, and provide optimized engineering solutions for safe marine transport.
•    Produce detailed fabrication drawings, material specifications, and construction guidelines for workshops and vendors.
Project Support & Execution
    •    Support project teams during loadout, lifting, securing, and discharge operations, providing on‑site engineering supervision where required.
•    Conduct structural inspections of fabricated materials to ensure compliance with approved drawings and specifications.
•    Assist in preparing and reviewing method statements, transport engineering studies, and risk assessments.
Compliance & Technical Assurance    •    Ensure all engineering solutions comply with Class, Flag, and international marine and structural standards.
•    Liaise with classification societies for design approval, engineering submissions, and follow-up of comments and revisions.
•    Maintain strict adherence to safety standards, company procedures, and project‑specific requirements.
Coordination & Stakeholder Engagement
    •    Collaborate closely with internal teams—operations, HSE, commercial, fabrication, and procurement.
•    Communicate technical requirements clearly to clients, subcontractors, shipyards, and workshop teams.
•    Support tender engineering by preparing preliminary concepts, estimates, and technical clarifications.
Documentation & Compliance    •    Prepare project execution reports, progress updates, daily logs, and completion summaries.
•    Monitor project schedules, identify risks or delays, and propose mitigation measures.
•    Track project costs and contribute to budget planning and cost‑control activities.
Operational Optimization
    •    Support continual improvement by identifying operational bottlenecks and proposing process enhancements.
•    Coordinate with commercial and technical teams on lessons learned and improvements for future projects.
Engineering Support    •    Provide engineering support to the Business Units (modification of the vessels, Rules and regulations compliance, etc.).
•    Assisting the line manager in any other technical related tasks whenever required.
Job Profile    (Internal)
QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

Minimum Experience & Qualifications:

•    Bachelor’s degree in Naval Architecture, Marine/Civil Engineering, or related field. 
•    5+ years of experience in strucural design/marine operations, transport & installation, or heavy lift/deck carrier projects..

Job-Specific Skills: 
•    Proficiency in Microsoft Office
•    Excellent analytical, communication, decision-making, and client-facing skills.
•    Ability to manage multimodal transport chains and complex project environments
•    Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple tenders simultaneously.
•    Excellent English language skills, with additional languages preferable
•    Self-motivated, driven and with attention to detail
•    Willingness to travel locally and internationally for port calls, loadouts, and project operations.
•    Strong competency in structural design tools (e.g., STAAD, SACS, ANSYS, Autodesk products, or equivalent).
•    Demonstrated experience with grillage/sea-fastening, loadout engineering, and structural verification of heavy cargo.
•    Experience working with deck carriers/barges or module transport vessels.
•    Familiarity with DNV, ABS, LR, or comparable classification societies.
•    Knowledge of IMO standards, relevant offshore transport engineering guidelines, and marine warranty surveyor (MWS) requirements.
items.ShortDescriptionStr: The Structural Engineer will provide technical expertise and engineering support for transport and installation operations related to project logistics, with a strong focus on deck carriers, heavy cargo handling, grillage/sea-fastening design, and structural integrity assessments. This role is critical to ensuring safe, compliant, and efficient project execution across marine transport operations.
